text: この　＊こそ　わしの　きゅうきょくの　わざを　ひきつぐに　ふさわしい…！

structure.jp: わしの　きゅうきょくの　わざを　ひきつぐに

patterns.name: 〜こそ
patterns.explanation: こそ after a word singles it out strongly: this one and no other. この　＊こそ = 'this ＊ is the very one'.

patterns.name: 〜にふさわしい
patterns.span: ひきつぐに　ふさわしい
patterns.explanation: に before ふさわしい says what someone is worthy of or suited for. ひきつぐに　ふさわしい = 'worthy of inheriting it'.
